# amm-ds — ML/AI Engineering Portfolio (site map)

> Published documentation for https://amm-ds.github.io/portfolio/ — one
> reproducible case study per project, the platform's engineering record, and
> the services page. Filed by Diátaxis: tutorials (how-this-was-built),
> how-to (runbooks), reference (data registry, ADR index), explanation
> (ADRs, audits).

## Start here

- [index.md](index.md) — home: flagships (07 mobility, 01 RAG) with pinned measured results.
- [projects/index.md](projects/index.md) — the 13 case studies at a glance; each page links problem → design record → evaluation artifacts.

## Projects (case studies)

Each `projects/NN-*.md` is one experiment rendered from its `story.yaml`
(background → objectives → data → EDA → training → evaluation → results →
conclusions), with the honest delta vs the naive baseline:

- [01 RAG & Agentic AI Assistant](projects/01-rag-agent.md) — cited answers from a pinned 593-article corpus; retrieval recall@5 0.831; auditable, not unattended-trustworthy.
- [02 Demand Forecasting](projects/02-demand-forecasting.md) — Walmart M5 full panel: 30,490 series, official hierarchical WRMSSE 0.6161 vs 0.8929 naive.
- [03 Anomaly Detection over Telemetry](projects/03-anomaly-detection.md) — NAB at a 2% alert budget; page the alert stream, not the detector score.
- [04 NLP Classification](projects/04-nlp-classification.md) — AG News 120k fine-tune, 0.9460 macro-F1; keyword routing keeps 3 of 4 items cheap.
- [05 Churn Modeling](projects/05-ml-pipeline-churn.md) — sklearn pipelines, cost-aware HPO; decision cost −41.9% with a bootstrap CI.
- [06 Routing Optimization](projects/06-routing-optimization.md) — hand-written ALNS within 4.23% of best-known on 56 Solomon VRPTW instances.
- [07 Urban Mobility Demand Intelligence](projects/07-open-data-mobility.md) — 41.2M trips, zone-hour forecasting −28.3% vs persistence; live drift observatory.
- [08 LLM Inference & Serving](projects/08-inference-serving.md) — five local serving setups, latency percentiles vs concurrency, GGUF-vs-MLX panel.
- [09 Agentic Workflows](projects/09-agentic-workflows.md) — plan-act-review loop, fixed tools and budgets; 15/15 tuning tasks, sealed held-out set.
- [10 Uplift & Experimentation](projects/10-uplift-experimentation.md) — Hillstrom RCT: T/X-learner uplift, CUPED, Qini and profit curves.
- [11 DataFrame Engines Benchmark](projects/11-data-engineering.md) — ten tasks × pandas/Polars/DuckDB/sqlite behind a parity gate; Polars ×19.2.
- [12 Tabular ML & Deep Learning Lifecycle](projects/12-tabular-ml-lifecycle.md) — seeded ladder to a hand-written PyTorch MLP; 25.4 test MAE, bootstrap CIs.
- [13 Model API Serving & Docker](projects/13-model-serving.md) — ONNX behind a parity gate, FastAPI service, load harness, measured image.

## Repo source of truth

The site renders `docs/` in the GitHub repository; the runnable code, tests,
and reproduction commands live at https://github.com/amm-ds/portfolio (root
`llms.txt` there maps the repo for agents). Install the root Python workspace
with `uv sync --all-packages --dev` after dependency changes; standalone apps
under `apps/` document their own isolated setup commands.
